app_info.subtitle: Trusted Human Design charts
app_info.description: HumanDesign.ai connects ChatGPT to the validated, versioned calculation service that powers HumanDesign.ai. It returns structured individual and composite Human Design chart data, can create or retrieve the signed-in user's primary chart, renders authorized charts and saved composites as deterministic PNG or SVG graphics, searches permitted library records, reports account usage, reads existing report status, and inspects entitled Website Builder projects. OAuth scopes, membership, workspace role, ownership, and entitlements filter account tools; protected API keys expose calculation-only tools. This release does not generate or deliver reports, create or publish websites, operate community features, or perform business actions.

test_cases.description: Inspect the signed-in account boundary before doing account-connected work.
test_cases.user_prompt: What HumanDesign.ai information and actions can I safely access with this connection?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the active personal account or workspace, role, membership, entitlements, and currently enabled capabilities without changing quota or account state.

test_cases.description: Preview primary-chart creation without charging or replacing an existing chart.
test_cases.user_prompt: I do not have a primary chart yet. Preview creating mine from the fictional details 1990-01-15 at 10:30 in London, United Kingdom, and wait for my confirmation before you create it.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns normalized birth details, any location or accuracy warning, a one-calculation-unit quote, and a short-lived confirmation; it does not execute before confirmation and returns an existing primary chart without another charge if one already exists.

test_cases.description: Render the signed-in user's primary chart as an inline image with a fallback link.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show my saved primary Human Design bodygraph as a portrait PNG.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a deterministic PNG image block and a short-lived download link for the authorized primary chart, with a free billing envelope and no claim of success if the image cannot be verified.

test_cases.description: Find and render an authorized saved composite relationship chart.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find my saved composite relationship charts, let me choose one, and render the selected bodygraph as an SVG.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns only authorized saved composites, then renders the selected composite as an SVG image with a short-lived fallback link; an empty search result is handled without exposing another workspace.

test_cases.description: List entitled Website Builder projects without starting or publishing work.
test_cases.user_prompt: List the HumanDesign.ai Website Builder projects I am allowed to see and show each project's current state.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the entitled project list or an empty list inside the connected boundary without starting a build, publishing a site, or exposing integration secret values.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for a Western astrology horoscope request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Calculate my Western astrology natal horoscope and tell me my rising sign.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because Western astrology calculations are outside its Human Design workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for medical diagnosis or treatment advice.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Use Human Design to diagnose the cause of my chest pain and tell me which medication to take.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked for diagnosis or treatment; the assistant should provide an appropriate medical-safety response instead.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger an unreleased Website Builder publish or domain action.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Publish my Website Builder project now and connect a new production domain without opening HumanDesign.ai.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because publishing and domain changes are not exposed in this release and require a secure HumanDesign.ai workflow.
